summary: Three consecutive uncovered days make the timing of the next home visit matter.
realLife: Shaheed described a gap that ran from Saturday through Monday before her aide returned on Tuesday.
gates: The schedule shows consecutive gaps and a confirmed next visit.
inGame: needs: a visit calendar with a confirmed next visit.

turns.what: A substitute breaks the gap on its first day.
turns.pulledBy: A worker accepts the weekend assignment.
turns.writesBack: The schedule shows a shorter interval without help.

turns.what: The usual aide confirms the next visit.
turns.pulledBy: No substitute can cover the intervening days.
turns.writesBack: The resident knows when help will resume.
